attestations.text: ERDENI 額爾德尼, d. 1623, of the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner, was a member of the Nara clan whose ancestral home was in Duyengge 都英額. He distinguished himself as a youth by his knowledge of the Mongol and Chinese languages and after joining the service of Nurhaci [q. v.] was useful to him as an interpreter and was given the title, baksi (巴克什, professor).

accounts.evidence: 額爾德尼，納喇氏，世居都英額。少明敏，兼通蒙古、漢文。太祖時來歸，隸正黃旗滿洲。從伐蒙古諸部，能因其土俗、語言、文字宣示意旨，招納降附。賜號『巴克什』。
